51300.meaning1: with mind as chief; ruled by mind
51300.commentary: (DHPa) evaṃ adhipativasena pana mano seṭṭho etesan'ti manoseṭṭhā. yathā hi gaṇ'ādīnaṃ adhipati puriso gaṇaseṭṭho seṇiseṭṭh'oti vuccati, tathā tesam'pi mano'va seṭṭho.

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
tīṇi soceyyāni, kāyasoceyyaṃ, vacīsoceyyaṃ, manosoceyyaṃ.
eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.

51303.commentary: (THa) manovicāre uparundha cetaso'ti manovicārasaññino gehasita-somanass'upavicār'ādike aṭṭhārasa cetaso uparundha vārehi nirodhehi.

examples.text: aniccaṃ dukkhan'ti vipassa yoniso, suññaṃ anattā'ti aghaṃ vadhan'ti ca, manovicāre uparundha cetaso, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

51304.meaning1: thinking and knowing; mind consciousness; mental awareness; sentience
51304.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇāni. itaraṃ pana mano'y'eva viññāṇan'ti manoviññāṇaṃ. dvipañcaviññāṇavajjassa tebhūmakavipākacittass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ.

51305.meaning1: knowing; mind consciousness element; mental awareness
51305.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manoviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manoviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

51307.meaningLit: to be known by mind knowing

examples.text: manaṃ, āvuso channa, manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasī'ti?

51308.meaning2: to be comprehended by the mind
51308.meaningLit: to be known by the mind

examples.text: ye te manoviññeyyā dhammā aviññātā aviññātapubbā, na ca vijānāsi, na ca te hoti vijāneyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
bhusā ce'pi manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.

51309.meaning1: thought; (comm) thought arisen in the mind

examples.text: kummo aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.

51312.meaning1: mantra; scripture; sacred hymn; Veda; chant

examples.text: asajjhāyamalā mantā, anuṭṭhānamalā gharā, malaṃ vaṇṇassa kosajjaṃ, pamādo rakkhato malaṃ.
ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yen'ekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatā'pi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pag'eva asajjhāyakatā?

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā
7. vaggā pañcapañcaso m'antā.

51315.meaning1: who masters the Vedas; reciter of the Vedas

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, mantajjhāyakassa mantajjhāyakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

51316.meaning1: mere fact of being a reciter of the Vedas

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ubbhaṭṭhakassa ubbhaṭṭhakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyāyabhattikassa pariyāyabhattikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, mantajjhāyakassa mantajjhāyakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
bhavañ'hi soṇadaṇḍo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti. bahū kho pana nānādisā nānājanapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa santike mant'atthikā mante adhiyitu'kāmā…

51319.meaning1: bearer of the Vedas; Vedic reciter
51319.commentary: (APAa) mantadharo'ti mantānaṃ dhāretā'ti attho, vedasaṅkhātassa catutthavedassa sajjhāyana-savana-dānānaṃ vasena dhāretā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ambaṭṭho nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo
uppātesu nimittesu, lakkhaṇesu ca kovidaṃ, ajjhāyakaṃ mantadharaṃ, porohicce ṭhapeti so.
atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā, tasmiṃ padese ṭhito tadeva mantanaṃ manteyya, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āha, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āhā'ti.
etadatthā, bhikkhave, kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sot'āvadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho'ti.
aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.

atha kho kāpaṭiko māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yadidaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ itih'itihaparam'parāya piṭakasampadāya, tattha ca brāhmaṇā ek'aṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchanti, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti?
ajjhāyakakule jātā, brāhmaṇā mantabandhavā, te ca pāpesu kammesu, abhiṇham'upadissare.

51324.commentary: (THa) mantabhāṇī'ti mantā vuccati paññā, tāya pana upaparikkhitvā bhaṇatī'ti mantabhāṇī, kālavādīādibhāvaṃ avissajjento'y'eva bhaṇatī'ti attho. mantabhaṇanavasena vā bhaṇatī'ti mantabhāṇī, dubbhāsitato vinā attano bhāsanavasena caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ subhāsitaṃ'y'eva bhaṇatī'ti attho.

examples.text: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto'ti.
akkodhano asantāsī, avikatthī akukkuco, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, sa ve vācāyato muni.
katamāni cattāri? saccavācā, apisuṇā vācā, saṇhā vācā, mantabhāsā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri vacīsucaritānī'ti.
aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.
kim'idaṃ kusalaṃ kim'ācarema, icc'eke hi samecca mantayanti, te mayaṃ punareva laddha mānusattaṃ, paṭipannā viharemu sīlavanto.
assosi kho āyasmā anuruddho dāyapālassa bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānassa
satthukappena vata kira, bho, sāvakena saddhiṃ mantayamānā na jānimha, āyasmā sāriputto'ti.
ahitaṃ vata te ñātī, mantayiṃsu rahogatā, ye taṃ jiṇṇassa pādaṃsu, evaṃ dahariyaṃ satiṃ.

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

51330.meaning1: having consulted (about); having discussed; having deliberated (on)
51330.meaning2: having consulted (on); having discussed; having deliberated
51330.commentary: (SNPa) so'pi tayā mantayitvā'ti tayā saddhiṃ mantayitvā, pañhaṃ pucchitvā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, yen'atthena devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, taṃ atthaṃ cintayitvā taṃ atthaṃ mantayitvā vuttavacanā'pi taṃ cattāro mahārājāno tasmiṃ atthe honti.
āgañchi te santike nāgarājā, erāvaṇo nāma jino'ti sutvā, so'pi tayā mantayitv'ājjhagamā, sādhū'ti sutvāna patītarūpo.

51331.meaning1: diplomatic battle; war of wits; political warfare; (comm) war with magic spells

examples.text: santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mah'āmattā, ye pahonti āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ. tesam'pi, bhante, mantayuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
na tattha hatthīnaṃ bhūmi, na rathānaṃ na pattiyā, na c'āpi mantayuddhena, sakkā jetuṃ dhanena vā.
yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.
mūlaṃ papañcasaṅkhāya, mantā asmī'ti sabbam'uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe.

51333.commentary: (DNa) mantass'ājīvino'ti mantā vuccati paññā, taṃ nissayaṃ katvā ye jīvanti paṇḍitā mah'āmattā, tesaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, amaccā pārisajjā gaṇakamah'āmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā mantass'ājīvino sannipatitvā rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhābhisittaṃ etadavocuṃ, na kho te, deva, samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato pubben'āparaṃ janapadā pabbanti, yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānānaṃ.

51334.meaning1: wise council; wise words; words of wisdom

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? saccavācā, apisuṇā vācā, saṇhā vācā, mantavācā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri vacīsucaritānī'ti.
m'āvamaññetha pāpassa, na man'taṃ āgamissati, udabindunipātena, udakumbho'pi pūrati, bālo pūrati pāpassa, thokaṃ thokam'pi ācinaṃ.

51336.synonym: kosalla, dhī, paññā, paññāṇa, paṭibhāṇa, paṭibhānaka, paṇḍicca, paṇḍiccā, paṇḍitabhāva, buddhi, mati, medhā, vijjā
51336.commentary: (THa) mantabhāṇī'ti mantā vuccati paññā, tāya pana upaparikkhitvā bhaṇatī'ti mantabhāṇī, kālavādīādibhāvaṃ avissajjento'y'eva bhaṇatī'ti attho.

examples.text: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto'ti.

51337.meaning1: family name of a Sakyan arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in giving Dhamma talks
51337.commentary: (MNa) puṇṇo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. mantāṇiyā pana so putto, tasmā mantāṇiputto'ti vuccati. (MNa) mantāṇiputto'ti mantāṇiyā brāhmaṇiyā putto. (ANa) puṇṇo mantāṇiputto'ti nāmena puṇṇo, mantāṇibrāhmaṇiyā pana so putto'ti mantāṇiputto. tassa pañhakamme ayam'anupubbikathā, ayaṃ kira padum'uttara-dasabalassa uppattito puretaram'eva haṃsavatīnagare brāhmaṇamahāsālakule nibbatti. tassa nāmaggahaṇadivase gotamo'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. so vayappatto tayo vede uggaṇhitvā sabbasippesu kovido hutvā pañcamāṇavakasataparivāro vicaranto tayo'pi vede oloketvā mokkhadhammaṃ adisvā idaṃ vedattayaṃ nāma kadalikkhandho viya bahi maṭṭhaṃ anto nissāraṃ, imaṃ gahetvā vicaraṇaṃ thusakoṭṭanasadisaṃ hoti. kiṃ me iminā'ti isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā brahmavihāre nibbattetvā aparihīnajjhāno brahmalokok'ūpapanno bhavissāmī'ti pañcahi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ pabbatapādaṃ gantvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbaji. tassa parivārāni aṭṭhārassa jaṭilasahassāni ahesuṃ. so pañca abhiññā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbattetvā tesam'pi kasiṇaparikammaṃ ācikkhi. te tassa ovāde ṭhatvā sabbe'pi pañca abhiññā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbattesuṃ. (APAa) mantāṇiputto'ti mantāṇīnāmāya kappakadhītuyā putto, māsapuṇṇatāya divasapuṇṇatāya puṇṇo'ti laddhanāmo'ti attho.
51337.notes: Theragāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to him.

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, bhante, āyasmā mantāṇiputto jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto.

51338.meaning1: name of a Brahman woman; mother of Aṅgulimāla
51338.notes: The Pali form appears to be from √mant but the Sanskrit form is from √mith mitra. See Mahāvastu 3.377

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, lābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, suladdhalābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa, yassa viññū sabrahmacārī satthu sammukhā anumassa anumassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, tañ'ca satthā abbhanumodati.

51339.meaning1: relying on mantras; supported by scripture
51339.commentary: (ANa) sesapadesu pan'ettha ayam'adhippāyo, brāhmaṇā tāva mante labhitvā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti, gahapatikā yaṃkiñci sippaṃ, itthī kuladāyajjasāmikaṃ puttaṃ, corā yaṃkiñci āvudhasatthaṃ, samaṇā sīlaparipuṇṇā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti. tasmā mant'ādhiṭṭhānā'tiādīni vuttāni.

51340.meaning1: family name of a Sakyan arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in giving Dhamma talks
51340.commentary: (MNa) mantāṇiyā pana so putto, tasmā mantāṇiputto'ti vuccati. (MNa) mantāṇiputto'ti mantāṇiyā brāhmaṇiyā putto. (AN1.196) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto.
51340.notes: Theragāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to him.

examples.text: sabbe kho ete, bhikkhave, bhikkhū dibbacakkhukā. passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, puṇṇaṃ mantāniputtaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mah'āmattā, ye pahonti āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ. tesam'pi, bhante, mantayuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.

asappuriso, bhikkhave, assaddhammasamannāgato hoti, asappurisabhatti hoti, asappurisacintī hoti, asappurisamantī hoti, asappurisavāco hoti, asappurisakamm'anto hoti, asappurisadiṭṭhi hoti, asappurisadānaṃ deti.

51345.meaning1: should be discussed; should be deliberated
51345.meaning2: should be discussed; should be deliberated

examples.text: gamanīyo samparāyo'ti paraloko pana avassaṃ gantabbo'va, tattha paṇḍitena kulaputtena mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ. mantā vuccati paññā, tāya mantetabbaṃ bujjhitabbaṃ, upaparikkhitabbañ'ca jānitabbañ'cā'ti attho. karaṇ'atthe vā bhummaṃ.

51346.commentary: (SNPa) paṭicchannena mantetī'ti atthaṃ ācikkhanto'pi yathā so na jānāti, tathā apākaṭehi padabyañjanehi paṭicchannena vacanena manteti, ācariyamuṭṭhiṃ vā katvā dīgharattaṃ vasāpetvā sāvasesam'eva manteti.

examples.text: aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.
yo atthaṃ pucchito santo, anattham'anusāsati, paṭicchannena manteti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

51347.meaning1: to discuss; to deliberate; to hold a conversation
51347.meaning2: to consult, to take counsel, to discuss

51348.meaning1: having discussed; having taken counsel; having deliberated
51348.meaning2: having consulted, having taken counsel, having discussed

examples.text: sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā, māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno, ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā, vicinanti brahāvane.

51349.commentary: (VINa) mantentan'ti aññena saddhiṃ aññasmiṃ mantayamāne, mantente'ti vā pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho

examples.text: bhikkhussa ṭhit'okāsaṃ vā nisinn'okāsaṃ vā nipann'okāsaṃ vā āgantvā mantentaṃ ukkāsitabbaṃ, vijānāpetabbaṃ, no ce ukkāseyya vā vijānāpeyya vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

51351.meaning1: biscuit; (comm) sweet made with flour, sesame and rice for a journey

seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso navanīt'atthiko navanītagavesī navanītapariyesanaṃ caramāno udakaṃ kalase āsiñcitvā manthena āviñcheyya.

51355.meaning1: dull; dull-witted; slow; stupid; not bright

andhabālo'si, mahārāja, kiñ'c'āpi mahābhakkho'si, anekasūpabyañjanavikatikaṃ doṇapākaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjasi, dvīsu raṭṭhesu rajjaṃ kāresi, paññā pana te mandā'ti

51356.synonym: ajānaka, aññajana, aviddasu, dattu, duppañña, dummedha, bāla

examples.text: middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.
ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako hatthena vā pādena vā aṅgāraṃ akkamitvā khippam'eva paṭisaṃharati.
tena kho pana samayena daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako abhayassa rājakumārassa aṅke nisinno hoti.

51363.meaning1: ignorance; stupidity; confusion; (comm) state of being stupid and not knowing

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā aññaṃ byākaroti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato aññaṃ byākaroti, ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṃ byākaroti, adhimānena aññaṃ byākaroti, samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaroti.
mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātu'kāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati

51366.meaning1: very dull; extremely slow; very weak
51366.commentary: (VINa) mandamando'ti abhikkant'ādīnaṃ anuddhatatāya atimando. atisaṇho'ti evaṃ guṇam'eva dosato dassenti.

examples.text: uppajjamānā'pi ca vaṭṭ'ānusāri-mahājanass'eva maddantā pharantā chādentā andhakāraṃ karontā na uppajjanti, mandamandā uppajjanti tanuk'ākārā hutvā, abbhapaṭalam'iva makkhikāpattam'iva ca.

51369.meaning1: name of a group of deities
51369.commentary: (DNa) āguṃ mandavalāhakā'ti vātavalāhakā, abbhavalāhakā, uṇhavalāhakā ete sabbe'pi valāhakāyikā mandavalāhakā' nāma vuccanti. te'pi āgatā'ti attho.

examples.text: sūriyass'ūpanisā devā, sūriyam'āguṃ purakkhatvā, nakkhattāni purakkhatvā, āguṃ mandavalāhakā.

51372.meaning2: name of a great lake, and of a river

51373.commentary: (VINa) mandāmukhiyo'ti aggibhājanāni vuccanti. (PYt) vitthiṇṇamukhattā mandaṃ hīnaṃ atimukham'etāsan'ti vacan'atthena aggikapālā mandāmukhiyo'ti vuccantī'ti āha aggibhājanāni vuccantī'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā pañcamattāni mandāmukhisatāni abhinimmini, yattha te jaṭilā uttaritvā visibbesuṃ.
dibbāni'pi mandāravapupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dibbāni'pi mandāravapupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.

51378.commentary: (DNa) passa kaṇhassa mandiyan'ti kāḷakassa mārasa bālabhāvaṃ passatha. (SNa) mandiyā nū'ti mandabhāvena momūhabhāvena.

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
te ca sabbe abhikkante, sainde deve sabrahmake, mārasenā abhikkāmi, passa kaṇhassa mandiyaṃ.

51379.commentary: (DNa) hiri netti ca mandiyo'ti hiri ca netti ca mandiyo ca.

examples.text: gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

51380.commentary: (JAa) sakaṃ mandiran'ti rājadhānigehaṃ gantvā. (JAa) mandire'ti mandiraṃ, bhavanan'ti attho.

examples.text: mutto ca so poris'ādassa hatthā, gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī, taṃ saṅkaraṃ brāhmaṇassappadāya, āmantayī puttam'alīnasattaṃ.

51382.commentary: (ANa) kāmabhogīnaṃ yadidaṃ rājā mandhātā'ti yo esa rājā mandhātā nāma, ayaṃ dibbe'pi mānusakepi kāme paribhuñjanakānaṃ sattānaṃ aggo nāma. esa hi asaṅkheyy'āyukesu manussesu nibbattitvā icchit'icchitakkhaṇe hiraññavassaṃ vassāpento mānusake kāme dīgharattaṃ paribhuñji. devaloke pana yāva chattiṃsāya indānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ, tāva paṇīte kāme paribhuñjīti kāmabhogīnaṃ aggo nāma jāto.
51382.notes: MW suggests ' a thoughtful or pious man'.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, attabhāvīnaṃ yadidaṃ, rāhu asur'indo. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmabhogīnaṃ yadidaṃ, rājā mandhātā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, ādhipateyyānaṃ yadidaṃ, māro pāpimā.
cattāro mahārājāno mandhātumahārājā āgato'ti sutvā'va mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo rājā na sakkā yuddhena paṭibāhitun'ti sakarajjaṃ niyyātesuṃ.

51384.meaning1: in my presence; into my presence; to me

examples.text: ye te, sunakkhatta, bhikkhū mama santike aññaṃ byākaṃsu… sant'etth'ekacce bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu, santi pan'idh'ekacce bhikkhū adhimānena'pi aññaṃ byākaṃsu.
sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.
atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena theraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi, satthā taṃ, āvuso thera, āmantetī'ti.
mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, aham'p'āyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, viramath'āyasmanto mama vacanāyā'ti.
ehi tvaṃ, tāta sudassana, bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhatt'ābhihāre bhāsa. ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti.
yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante
rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.

siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu, yañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja viharato ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā na honti tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ upasampajja vihareyyā'ti?
sabbaloke ca atam'mayo bhavissāmi, ahaṅ'kārā ca me uparujjhissanti, mamaṅ'kārā ca me uparujjhissanti

51390.meaning1: after my passing away; after my death; when I am gone

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi vā mam'accaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, tama't'agge mete, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā'ti.

51391.meaning1: after my passing away; after my death; when I am gone
51391.meaning2: after my passing away; after my death

examples.text: yo vo, ānanda, mayā dhammo ca vinayo ca desito paññatto, so vo mam'accayena satthā.
atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, mamañ'ca khv'āyaṃ kulaputto uddissa pabbajito. yaṃnūn'ass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan'ti.
evam'evaṃ pan'idh'ekacce moghapurisā mamaññ'eva ajjhesanti. dhamme ca bhāsite mamaññ'eva anubandhitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.

51394.commentary: (THa) tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ lokan'ti yathā araññe apariggahe tiṇakaṭṭhe kenaci gayhamāne aparassa mayhaṃ santakaṃ ayaṃ gaṇhatī'ti na hoti, evaṃ so asāmikatāya tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ saṅkhāralokaṃ yadā paññāya passati, so tattha mamattaṃ asaṃvindaṃ asaṃvindanto alabhanto akaronto.

examples.text: tiṇakaṭṭhasamaṃ lokaṃ, yadā paññāya passati, mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ, n'atthi me'ti na socati.
maraṇena'pi taṃ pahīyati, yaṃ puriso mam'idan'ti maññati, etam'pi viditvā paṇḍito, na mamattāya nametha māmako.

51395.meaning1: use for me (with); need (of) for me

examples.text: evam'pi … atha vā pana … kiṃ nu me buddhenā'ti vadati viññāpeti … kiṃ nu me sabrahmacārīhī'ti vadati viññāpeti… na mam'attho buddhenā'ti vadati viññāpeti … na mam'attho sabrahmacārīhī'ti vadati viññāpeti… evam'pi, bhikkhave, dubbaly'āvikammañ'c'eva hoti sikkhā ca paccakkhātā.
tassa rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ samanvesato yāvatā viññāṇassa gati, yam'pi'ssa taṃ hoti ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā tam'pi tassa na hotī'ti.
kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.
atha kho aparā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kassa nu kho, bhagavā, subhāsitan'ti? sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca mama'pi suṇātha

51398.meaning1: who eats my food; who I feed; who eats with me

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ime isidattapurāṇā thapatayo mamabhattā mamayānā, ahaṃ nesaṃ jīvikāya dātā, yasassa āhattā, atha ca pana no tathā mayi nipaccakāraṃ karonti yathā bhagavati.

51399.meaning1: who uses my vehicle; who travels in my carriage; who travels with me

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ime isidattapurāṇā thapatayo mamabhattā mamayānā, ahaṃ nesaṃ jīvikāya dātā, yasassa āhattā, atha ca pana no tathā mayi nipaccakāraṃ karonti yathā bhagavati.
